en: A sepia-toned postcard showing an old European city scene. In the foreground is a multi-story historic house with steep, tiled roofs, dormer windows, and wooden shutters, some of them open. Behind and above it rises a prominent hilltop clock tower with a large clock face, wooden superstructure, and steep roof. Vegetation and a stone wall line the hillside. The print is bordered by a wide cream margin, with handwritten text at the bottom of the image.
